description.zh: 伊势神宫是日本地位最崇高的神社，供奉皇室祖先神——天照大御神（内宫）与掌管衣食住的丰受大御神（外宫）。神宫建筑采用唯一御用式年迁宫制度，每20年在相邻地址重建一次（最近一次为2013年），维持建筑的「永恒新生」，这一传统已延续约1,300年。
description.en: Ise Jingū is Japan's most sacred Shinto shrine complex, enshrining the Imperial ancestor deity Amaterasu-Ōmikami (Inner Shrine, Naikū) and Toyouke-Ōmikami, goddess of food and livelihood (Outer Shrine, Gekū). Under the unique Shikinen Sengū system, the entire complex is ritually rebuilt on an adjacent site every 20 years (most recently 2013) — a tradition of 'eternal renewal' maintained for ~1,300 years.

location.zh: 三重县伊势市（外宫·内宫）
location.en: Ise City, Mie Prefecture (Gekū and Naikū)

zh: 内宫（皇大神宫）：供奉天照大御神，只有皇族与特定神职人员可进入最内侧正殿
式年迁宫：每20年如一重建，数百座建筑全套移建，使用与千年前相同的神明造建筑工法
おかげ横丁：内宫宇治橋前的传统参道商业街，售卖伊势乌冬、赤福等特产
en: Naikū (Inner Shrine): enshrines Amaterasu; only Imperial family and specific priests enter the innermost sanctuary
Shikinen Sengū: complete ritual reconstruction every 20 years using the same shinmei-zukuri architectural techniques as a millennium ago
Okage Yokochō: traditional monzenmachi in front of Naikū, famous for Ise udon noodles and akafuku rice-cake sweets

admission.en: Outer and Inner Shrine worship free

duration.zh: 半天至一天（外宫与内宫各需约1—2小时）
duration.en: Half to full day (each shrine ~1–2 hours)

tips.zh: 从名古屋乘近铁特急约1.5小时至宇治山田站或伊势市站。外宫与内宫相距约6公里，可乘巴士连接。参拜礼仪：两礼二拍手一礼，勿直接拍摄最内殿建筑。
tips.en: From Nagoya, take the Kintetsu Limited Express ~1.5 hours to Ujiyamada or Ise-shi station. Gekū and Naikū are 6 km apart — buses connect them. Etiquette: two bows, two claps, one bow; do not photograph the innermost sanctuary.
